name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical bathroom addition project can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to final inspection. This timeline is influenced by the scope of work, availability of materials, and local permit processing times. Obtaining permits from your local city or county in areas like Alameda or Berkeley can sometimes extend the overall timeline, so it's important to account for this step in your planning.
